read.thesis: Copper volumes guided up to 3.7 Bn lb in 2027 (+20%) and over 4.0 Bn lb in 2028 on Grasberg ramp, but 2026 volumes trimmed ~2% and 2027 ~2.5%, with 2027 capex up $400M to $5.2 Bn on inflation and equipment.

utilisation.quote: We operated at 67% of mine capacity during the third quarter

capex.peers_comment: Management said the industry has arguably been under-invested and that capital cost inflation trends above CPI; no specific peer capacity commentary.
capex.quote: we are seeing capital cost inflation. You see it in operating costs, but we also are seeing it in capital costs.

triggers.label: 2027 capex up $400M to $5.2Bn
triggers.quote: $5.2 billion for 2027, an increase of approximately $400 million above the July estimate

triggers.label: 2026 copper sales trimmed ~2%
triggers.quote: We have trimmed our 2026 copper sales by about 2%, taking into account slightly lower production in the U.S. and Chile

triggers.label: Realised copper $6.54/lb, +40% YoY
triggers.quote: Average Realized Copper Price -- $6.54 per pound, reflecting a 40% increase from $4.68 per pound

triggers.label: Grasberg block cave at 67% of capacity
triggers.quote: We operated at 67% of mine capacity during the third quarter

guidance.quote: We have trimmed our 2026 copper sales by about 2%
Copper sales in 2028 are consistent with previous estimates
we are maintaining our full year guidance for 2026 of $1.90 per pound

$5.2 billion for 2027, an increase of approximately $400 million above the July estimate
